subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: A heterogeneous cluster of generic runtime helpers: a DEFLATE-style Huffman tree-cost estimator and its run-length frequency analyzer; a bit-buffer symbol-block writer and a run/literal bitstream encoder sharing one flush contract; a frequency-ratio validator; free vector/math routines; a family of callback-registration thunks and once-guarded initializers around a shared registrar helper; global delegation wrappers; global flag/bitmask setters; a camera-director parameter broadcast; simple field accessors; several doubly/singly-linked list operations on distinct node layouts; a linked string dictionary and its audio-node list consumer; and channel-indexed input-control field IO.

summary: The packet resolves into twenty-eight defensible classes over thirty-eight functions, with every owner object still UNKNOWN. The DEFLATE complex splits into DeflateTreeCostCalculator (0x00538940: runs RunLengthAnalyzer over the two tree frequency tables at this+0xB12/0xB1E, builds the encoding tree via sub_5383D0, scans code lengths 18..3 through byte_5B7DEC and accumulates the cost 3*result+17 into this+0x169B), DeflateCodeLengthAnalyzer (0x005389B0: run-length frequency analysis with zero-run 138/3 versus non-zero 6/3 or 7/4 thresholds), DeflateBitstreamPacker (0x00538A90, 0x00538CE0: symbol-block writer and run/literal encoder sharing the 16-bit-accumulator flush contract), and FrequencyRatioValidator (0x00539600: sums 7/121/128 word entries and stores (v2 <= (v1>>2)) at this+0x1C). Free math lives in Vector3FloatOps (0x0053BDE0, 0x0053BE60) and ForceScaleComputation (0x0053BCE0). The registration family is CallbackRegistrationThunk (0x0053C150, 0x0053C1B0, 0x0053C210 forwarding target addresses to BooleanToIntConversion 0x00587B3E), OnceGuardedCallback (0x0053C160, 0x0053C220), DelegationWrapper_55EE20 (0x0053ACF0, 0x0053C140) and DirectXSurfaceInitDelegationWrapper (0x0053C200). Global state is handled by GlobalFlagSetter (0x0053D410, 0x0053D430), GlobalBitmaskControl (0x0054A1C0) and ParameterBroadcastChannel (0x0053D450). The list family keeps each distinct node layout separate: GlobalDoublyLinkedList (0x0053C5D0), SceneGraphNodeList (0x00545090), SoundSourceNodeList (0x005459D0), NodeAccumulatingList (0x00548810) and AudioNodeDictionaryList (0x00549380, consuming LinkedStringDictionary 0x0054A2D0). Simple accessors cover this+0x13B0/0x13D8/0xF8/0x110/0x190/0x44/0x6C/0x70 and the float store at this+0x8; InputControlChannelIO (0x00547140, 0x005471D0) groups the two channel-indexed field operations under their shared caller. No class grouping is CONFIRMED; the run-mode threshold state machine and the once-guard latch are the only state machines proposed.

function_roles.role: DEFLATE tree-encoding cost accumulation: runs RunLengthAnalyzer (0x005389B0) over the two tree frequency tables at this+0xB12 and this+0xB1E, builds the encoding tree via sub_5383D0(this, this+0xB26), scans the code-length alphabet through byte_5B7DEC from 18 down to 3, breaks at the highest code length whose WORD frequency at this+2676+4*index is non-zero (falling through with result 2 when none), and accumulates the tree-description cost 3*result+17 into the counter at this+0x169B; returns the found code length (2..18).

Run-length frequency analysis of a deflate code-length sequence: walks the a2 code-length array from element a2+2 with a sentinel -1 written at a2+4*a3+6, tracks consecutive identical values, switches thresholds between zero-run mode (max 138, min 3) and non-zero mode (6/3 or 7/4), and accumulates finished runs into per-value buckets plus a1[1369]/a1[1371]/a1[1373]; returns the remaining loop counter. Sole static caller AccumulateTreeEncodingCost (0x00538940).

Symbol-block bit-buffer writer: serializes the three prefix values (a2-257 as a 5-bit field, a3-1 as a 5-bit field, a4-4 as a 4-bit field) into the 16-bit accumulator, then loops a4 times packing a 3-bit code from the word table at offset 2676 indexed by byte_5B7DEC[i], flushing two accumulator bytes to the output buffer at cursor+20 over base+8 at each threshold, and closes the block with two CompressionBitstreamPacker (0x00538CE0) calls, returning the second result. Invoked by HuffmanBitStreamEncoder (0x005381F0).

Run-length/literal bitstream encoder: consumes a word stream (initial symbol at a2+2, following words from a2+6), emits short runs (v4 < v7) as repeated literals via the +2674/+2676 code table, non-zero runs via +2738/+2740 with two appended residual bits, and zero runs short (v4-3 via +2742/+2744, three residual bits) or long (v4-11 via +2746/+2748, seven residual bits), through a 16-bit accumulator at +5803 (high byte +5804, bit count +5805) flushed when the count crosses 16; returns the encoder state. Invoked by BitBufferWriter (0x00538A90).

Frequency-ratio validation: sums 7 word entries at this+0x8A and 128 word entries at this+0x28A into v2, 121 word entries at this+0xA6 into v1, computes (v2 <= (v1 >> 2)), stores that BOOL at this+0x1C and returns it. Called by HuffmanBitStreamEncoder (0x005381F0); the table ranges are presumed Huffman frequency tables but that interpretation is not packet-stated.
Thin __cdecl wrapper: discards its first argument a1 and forwards the remaining three (a2, a3, a4) unchanged to callee 0x0055EE20, returning the callee's result directly.

SSE force-scale computation: builds a 255.0f lane constant, assembles per-axis scale lanes from a2[17..19], scales the a1 direction components (this+0x18/0x1C/0x20) by the a1[9] magnitude (this+0x24), and writes the per-lane product into a3 via _mm_mul_ps. Straight-line with no branches, calls or guards.

Reversed-order dot product: builds [0, a1[2], a1[1], a1[0]] from this+0x0/0x4/0x8, multiplies lane-wise by the float vector *a2, and horizontally sums the four lanes via shuffle-add; returns the float scalar promoted to the double return type.

Squared Euclidean distance between two 3D vectors: computes the per-component differences a1[i]-a2[i] over this+0x0/0x4/0x8 and returns the sum of their squares as a double. Pure scalar math with no guards, globals or calls.

Stores the double value arriving in x87 register ST(2) as a 32-bit float into the field at offset 0x8 of the this object (__userpurge convention); parameters a3..a6 are unused by the body. Implicit void return.

Trivial forwarding wrapper: calls the ABI-named Call_FUN_00556220 (callee 0x0055EE20) with the address of global unk_8B6BD0 (0x008B6BD0) as its single argument, and returns the callee's int result unchanged.

Thin adapter: calls BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) with the address of sub_53C160 (0x0053C160) cast to int and returns the callee's result; if the callee stores the address this is callback registration, which the ABI cluster name Callback_Registration_53c150 supports.
One-time guarded initialization: when bit 0 of byte_8B8EE4 is clear, latches that bit and calls EmptyStub_7470 with the address of unk_8B6BD0, so the guarded setup runs at most once per process.

Thin zero-argument wrapper: casts the code address of sub_53C1C0 (0x0053C1C0) to int and forwards it to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), returning that helper's integer result unchanged. Structurally identical to the adjacent sibling thunks.
Trivial delegation wrapper: calls DirectXDeviceSurfaceInitialization with the address of global dword_8B78A0 (0x008B78A0) as its single argument, and returns the callee's int result unchanged.

Thin zero-argument wrapper: casts the code address of sub_53C220 (0x0053C220) to int and forwards it to the shared helper BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), returning that helper's integer result unchanged; same shape as the adjacent sibling thunks.

One-time guarded table registration: while bit 1 (value 1) of flag byte_8B8EE5 is clear, latches that bit, seeds a cursor to unk_8B8C38 and a counter to 8, then walks the cursor backwards in 68-byte steps calling EmptyStub_0170 before each decrement, running exactly 8 iterations at most once per process.

Doubly-linked-list append: links node a1 into the global list headed by dword_8B8F28 using prev/next at node+0x1E4/+0x1E8; when the head is null a1 becomes the head with both links cleared, otherwise the next-pointer chain is walked to the tail, the old tail's next is linked to a1 and a1's prev/next are set to the old tail and 0; returns the old tail, or a1 when the list was empty.

Global flag setter: computes the truthiness of the integer argument (a1 != 0), stores the resulting BOOL into dword_8B8E2C (0x008B8E2C) and returns it. Called by VidMan_Init (0x004FA320); the flag's consumers are not in this packet.

Global flag setter, structurally identical to the adjacent setter but writing a different global: computes the truthiness of the integer argument (a1 != 0), stores the BOOL into dword_8B8E24 (0x008B8E24) and returns it. Called by VidMan_Init (0x004FA320).

Guarded broadcast of an integer to a list of per-receiver float state slots: when dword_8B89A0 is nonzero, stages the argument at dword_8B8C50[13], then walks a float table starting at unk_8B8A58 with a 17-dword stride (count bounded by dword_8B8C50[0]), updating each differing entry and calling the object method at vtable offset 252 of *dword_8B89A0 with (object, entry index, 19, staged value), storing the returned int into dword_8B78A0 (0x008B78A0). Returns the loop bound, or 0 when the guard object is null. Called from MainCameraDirectorUpdate.

Getter __thiscall returning the integer field at offset 0x13B0 of this; no side effects, guards, globals or callees. Called by VertexBufferResourceAllocation (0x00543FA0), which reads the field during vertex-buffer resource setup.
Getter __thiscall returning the integer field at offset 0x13D8 of this; no side effects, guards, globals or callees. Called by sub_55D720 (0x0055D720), which consumes the returned value.
Trivial __thiscall getter returning the dword at offset 0x13D8 of this; no side effects, branches or calls.
Two-field getter: reads this+0x6C and this+0x70 and writes them through output pointers a2 and a3, each independently null-guarded, then returns a3. Invoked by sub_5550E0 (0x005550E0).
Conditional __thiscall getter: writes the dword at offset 0x190 of this into the caller-supplied output pointer a2 when a2 is non-null, then returns a2 unchanged.

Trivial __thiscall getter returning the dword at offset 0xF8 of this; no side effects, branches or calls. Single caller CUBESceneLoaderEntry (0x0048E8D0) may indicate a scene-related owner, unverified.
Trivial thiscall getter returning this[62], i.e. the dword at byte offset 0xF8 of the receiver; no side effects and no parameters beyond this.

Doubly-linked-list node removal: unlinks node a2 via its prev/next pointers at node+0x1B4/+0x1B8, and when the removed node is the current head (this+0xF8 == a2) advances the head to node->next and returns it; otherwise returns a2. Called by SceneGraphTreeDestructor (0x00544EF0) during scene-graph teardown.

Doubly-linked-list node removal: unlinks node a2 via its prev/next pointers at node+0x30/+0x34, and when the removed node is the current head (this+0x15C == a2) advances the head to node->next and returns it; otherwise returns a2. Called by F_3DSoundSourceDestructor (0x00545150) during 3D sound source teardown.
Getter __thiscall with no side effects: reads and returns the DWORD field at offset 0x110 (index 68) of the this object; field purpose and owning type are not identified by the packet.

Channel-indexed field dispatch via jump table jpt_54714C (0x005471B0): cases 1-4 each invoke the virtual method at vtable offset 16 of the object dword_8B8F24 with (a3, this+84/68/100/116) as the destination; the default case returns this; otherwise returns the virtual-call result. Invoked by ConstructorInputControlInit (0x00546250).

Channel-indexed float setter: dispatches on index a2 via jump table jpt_5471DA (0x00547224); for a2 in 1..4 stores (double)a3 * 0.0039215689 (flt_59E460, ~1/255) into this+0x60/0x50/0x70/0x80 for channels 1..4; the default case writes nothing. Every path returns a2-1. Called by ConstructorInputControlInit (0x00546250).

List accumulation pass: walks the singly-linked list headed by this+0x24, zeroes the accumulator fields this+0x0 and this+0x4, invokes the per-node cleanup/reset helper 0x00546430 on each node, then accumulates node fields (DWORD indices 37 and 38) into the accumulator slots; returns 0. The accumulation destination pointer is not explicitly initialized in the raw source.

__fastcall helper that unconditionally writes 0 to the DWORD field at offset 0x44 (68) of the object passed as the second argument (a2/EDX); the first and third parameters are unused. No guards, globals or callees; returns void.

List walk resolving each node through StringLookupInLinkedDictionary: iterates the linked list from head this+0xF8 following each node's next pointer at node+0x14 until null, calls 0x0054A2D0 on each node and stores the returned dictionary lookup result at node+0x10. Invoked from AudioEngineInitialization-side caller 0x00546010.

Global bitmask mutation of dword_8B8EE0 (0x008B8EE0): when a2 is non-zero the bits of a1 are OR-ed in (set); otherwise the inverted bits of a1 are AND-ed in (clear); the return value is the new logical state (a1 | global on set, ~a1 on clear). Referenced by VidMan_Init (0x004FA320).

Linear search of a linked string dictionary: loads the chain head from this+0x100 (null returns 0), walks nodes via the next pointer at node+0x104 comparing each node's string at node+8 against the input with strcmp, and returns the matching node pointer or 0. Invoked by LinkedListUpdate (0x00549380) and AudioNodeUpdateWalk (0x00549440).

classes.name: DeflateTreeCostCalculator
classes.responsibility: DEFLATE-style Huffman tree-encoding cost estimator: runs run-length frequency analysis over two tree frequency tables, builds the encoding tree via sub_5383D0, scans the code-length alphabet through byte_5B7DEC, and accumulates the tree-description bit cost 3*result+17 into the counter at this+0x169B.

classes.name: DeflateCodeLengthAnalyzer
classes.responsibility: Run-length frequency analysis of a deflate code-length sequence: tracks consecutive identical values with zero-run (138/3) versus non-zero (6/3 or 7/4) thresholds, terminates the scan with a sentinel -1, and accumulates finished runs into per-value frequency buckets.

classes.name: DeflateBitstreamPacker
classes.responsibility: Bit-buffer symbol-block writer and run/literal bitstream encoder sharing one flush contract: a 16-bit accumulator at offset 5803 (high byte 5804) with a bit-count dword at 5805, flushing two buffered bytes to the output buffer at cursor+20 over base+8 whenever the accumulated bit count crosses the field threshold.

classes.name: FrequencyRatioValidator
classes.responsibility: Frequency-ratio validation: sums 7 word entries at this+0x8A and 128 at this+0x28A against a quarter of the 121-entry sum at this+0xA6, stores the boolean comparison result at this+0x1C and returns it. The three table ranges are presumed Huffman frequency tables, but that interpretation is not packet-stated.

classes.name: ForceScaleComputation
classes.responsibility: SSE force-scale computation: scales the a1 direction components (this+0x18/0x1C/0x20) by the a1[9] magnitude (this+0x24), multiplies per axis by a2[17..19] scale lanes and a fixed 255.0f constant, and writes the per-lane product to the a3 output vector. Physics role is ABI-lead only.

classes.name: Vector3FloatOps
classes.responsibility: Free 3-float vector math routines: a reversed-order integer/float dot product (0x0053BDE0) and a squared-Euclidean-distance routine (0x0053BE60), both reading the three components at this+0x0/+0x4/+0x8. Grouping is DERIVED from the shared vector layout; a common owner class is unproven.

classes.responsibility: Stores the double arriving in x87 ST(2) (__userpurge) as a 32-bit float into the field at this+0x8; parameters a3..a6 are unused. Owning object and field meaning are unknown.

transitions.when: first code length value v3 == 0 selects zero-run thresholds (max 138, min 3)
first code length value v3 != 0 selects the default non-zero thresholds (max 7, min 4)
next value is still zero, thresholds remain 138/3
run completes and next value v74 is zero (thresholds 138/3)
run completes and next value v74 equals the previous value v3 (thresholds 6/3)
run completes and next value v74 differs from the previous value v3 (thresholds 7/4)
guard flag bit clear (byte_8B8EE4 bit 0 for the unk_8B6BD0 pass; byte_8B8EE5 bit 1 for the 68-byte table pass): the bit is latched first, then the guarded init runs; the pass is skipped forever after

interfaces.name: BitstreamWriteSink

compatibility_contracts.name: DeflateTreeEncodingCostFormula
compatibility_contracts.description: Tree-encoding cost accumulation must run run-length analysis over the two tree frequency tables (this+0xB12, this+0xB1E), build the encoding tree via sub_5383D0, scan code lengths 18 down to 3 through byte_5B7DEC, break at the highest code length whose WORD frequency at this+2676+4*index is non-zero (falling through with result 2 when none), add 3*result+17 to the counter at this+0x169B, and return the found code length.

compatibility_contracts.name: CodeLengthRunThresholds
compatibility_contracts.description: Run-length code-length processing must select thresholds per run value: zero runs use max 138 / min 3; non-zero runs use 6/3 when the next value equals the previous and 7/4 otherwise. The analyzer terminates the scan with a sentinel -1 at a2+4*a3+6; the packer emits short runs as literals and non-zero/zero runs with run counts reduced by 3 (non-zero and short zero) or 11 (long zero) plus 2/3/7 residual bits through the +2674/+2738/+2742/+2746 code tables.

compatibility_contracts.name: BitBufferFlushContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Both bit writers must keep a 16-bit accumulator (offset 5803, high byte 5804) with a bit-position dword at 5805, packing (code << bitpos) and flushing the two buffered bytes to the output buffer at cursor+20 over base+8 whenever the accumulated bit count crosses the field threshold (11/11/12/13/16 by field width), advancing the cursor by two and rebasing the accumulator.

compatibility_contracts.name: FrequencyRatioValidation
compatibility_contracts.description: Frequency-ratio validation must sum 7 word entries at this+0x8A and 128 word entries at this+0x28A into v2, 121 word entries at this+0xA6 into v1, compute (v2 <= (v1 >> 2)), store the BOOL at this+0x1C and return it.

compatibility_contracts.name: LinkedStringDictionaryLookup
compatibility_contracts.description: Linked string dictionary lookup must load the chain head at this+0x100 (return 0 when null), walk nodes via the next pointer at node+0x104 comparing each node's string at node+8 with strcmp, and return the matching node pointer or 0.

compatibility_contracts.name: DoublyLinkedListUnlinkContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Doubly-linked-list node removal must unlink the node via its prev/next pointers (scene-graph variant: node+0x1B4/+0x1B8 with head this+0xF8; sound-source variant: node+0x30/+0x34 with head this+0x15C), and when the removed node is the head advance the head to node->next and return it, otherwise return the node.

compatibility_contracts.name: GlobalDoublyLinkedListAppendContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Append to the global list headed by dword_8B8F28 must link the node via prev/next at node+0x1E4/+0x1E8: when the head is null the node becomes the head with both links cleared; otherwise the next-pointer chain is walked to the tail, the old tail's next is linked to the node and the node's prev/next set to the old tail and 0; return the old tail (or the node itself when the list was empty).

compatibility_contracts.name: GlobalFlagSetterContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The two video-manager flag setters must store (a1 != 0) as a BOOL into their global dword_8B8E2C / dword_8B8E24 and return the stored value; both are invoked by VidMan_Init (0x004FA320).

compatibility_contracts.name: GlobalBitmaskSetClearContract

compatibility_contracts.name: OnceGuardedInitializationContract
